messages:
sam (sec): ACME retest intake 1) lock window 2) finalize KMS grant model 3) evidence readroom + proofs. Who's available?

tara (ops): Ops free Fri 09:00-11:00 PT. Can do dry-run 08:30.

liam (platform): Hold Fri 09:00-11:00 PT. Plan: ephemeral data keys via GenerateDataKey + CreateGrant. Deny CMK Decrypt.

anita (sre): We'll tail logs and push snapshots every 10m to the evidence prefix. Need request_id propagated from token -> model.

emma (eng): I'll thread request_id and add it to function outputs. Also add a manifest script for sha256 checksums.

maria (compliance): Readroom requirements: manifest.sha256, metadata.json (access ledger), CloudTrail slices for GenerateDataKey/CreateGrant, and HMAC proof of the ledger. No CMK export.

liam (platform): Example grant snippet for ops:
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/acme-pt-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PT-AssessorRole --operations GenerateDataKey Encrypt Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"engagement":"acme"}}'

liam (platform): Grants will be TTL'd and revoked after window by automation.

tara (ops): Ops will provision s3://acme-pt-readroom-1769998887/ with lifecycle 30d and presigned URLs that expire at retention end. We'll produce HMAC-signed access ledger.

anita (sre): Dry-run revoke at 08:30 to validate revoke automation. Oncall will execute and upload artifacts.

sam (sec): Rollback playbook: revoke grants, rotate alias, failover to degraded model; contact list in tracker.

emma (eng): Tracker entry: https://redwood.internal/pt/ACME-RETEST-1769998887 1) eng owners 2) ops bucket 3) platform grants 4) sre dry-run.

maria (compliance): Acceptance: manifest+checksums, access ledger+HMAC, CloudTrail event slice, no CMK key material export, and documented rollback.

evidence-bot: Dry-run scheduled Fri 08:30 1) revoke test executed 2) snapshots uploaded to s3://acme-pt-readroom-1769998887/dryrun/.

sam (sec): Thanks all. Action items: emma -> tracker + request_id patch; tara -> bucket + HMAC job; liam -> grant CLI + revoke automation; anita -> schedule dry-run and monitor. Proceed with Fri slot unless blockers.

tara (ops): No blockers.

liam (platform): None.

anita (sre): Oncall OK.

emma (eng): Will deliver by EOD.

sam (sec): :thumbsup:
